properties.displayName: JA4proxy - Multiple Blocked Fingerprints from Single IP
properties.description: Detects when a single source IP presents multiple distinct JA4 TLS fingerprints in a short window. Fingerprint rotation is a common evasion technique used after an initial fingerprint is blocked. Correlates with MITRE ATT&CK T1190 (Exploit Public-Facing Application) and T1036 (Masquerading).
properties.query:
JA4proxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ja4proxy_action_s in ('blocked', 'banned')
| where isnotempty(ja4proxy_fingerprint_s)
| summarize
    DistinctFingerprints = dcount(ja4proxy_fingerprint_s),
    FingerprintList = make_set(ja4proxy_fingerprint_s, 20),
    BlockCount = count(),
    MaxScore = max(ja4proxy_risk_score_d),
    CountryCode = any(ja4proxy_country_code_s),
    ASNOrg = any(ja4proxy_asn_org_s),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by source_ip_s, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where DistinctFingerprints >= 3
| extend
    AlertTitle = strcat('Fingerprint rotation from ', source_ip_s, ': ', DistinctFingerprints, ' distinct fingerprints'),
    DurationMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', LastSeen, FirstSeen)

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Source IP {{source_ip_s}} presented {{DistinctFingerprints}} distinct TLS fingerprints across {{BlockCount}} blocked connections. Possible tool rotation after initial block.
